name: Cuisine du Cambodge - 02 - Publication approuvée Facebook et création Instagram

parameters.query: WITH chosen AS (SELECT id FROM cuisine_social.posts WHERE status='approved' AND human_decision='approved' AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_date <= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND fb_state='pending' AND ig_state='pending' ORDER BY scheduled_date,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) UPDATE cuisine_social.posts p SET status='publishing',fb_state='submitting',ig_state='creating',publishing_started_at=NOW(),updated_at=NOW() FROM chosen WHERE p.id=chosen.id RETURNING p.*
UPDATE cuisine_social.posts SET fb_state='published',facebook_post_id=$1,updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$2 AND fb_state='submitting' RETURNING *

parameters.body: ={{JSON.stringify({image_url:$('Claim atomique uniquement si validé').first().json.image_url,caption:$('Claim atomique uniquement si validé').first().json.instagram_caption})}}

parameters.query: UPDATE cuisine_social.posts SET instagram_container_id=$1,ig_state='container_created',updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$2 AND ig_state='creating' RETURNING id,fb_state,ig_state
